notes.title: Operation Theta: Massive content update. New Characters, New Quests, New CATS!
notes.notes:
It is finally here! Operation Theta (Content update one). We have added so much to the game from a lot of little changes suggested by you guys in the community to more content with three new characters all of which play VERY differently than anything before in the game. Lets get into it..

 New Characters 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/46abac86480988af777538de5bb031cbcf557545.png
Three new characters have been added to the game! Each with their own unique ways to play! 

Waylyyn: Is a Human member of the USF, She has excellent combat training and is equipped with a laser gun and placeable mines! Instead of building a ship like normal character she has to survive against increasingly difficult wave of enemies to escape the battle zone! With limited health and powerup pickups she will be a nice challenge for veterans of the game. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/4c229e5dd492dcaf030e9de163e496017300b973.png

Oottoo: Oottoo is a Slugula businessman. As such he plans to pay his way out of the battlezone! Ootto can sells debris from the battlefield to one of the three seller npcs on the map to get enough credits to escape! His ship has TWO grappling hooks instead of just one. You have to be able to hodl more to be a suave trader.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/9a36a0a8998462cbbf32ac6468eb9e44dff184e2.png

Goo: Goo is three characters in one! Goo's Special ability is to 'transform' into other forms to suit its needs. A Goo that can heal, A Brumpor that has a grapple tail and lastly a Golem who weighs a TON and will fall down to the nearest planet pretty quickly and can throw rocks! Goo is from our new game Goo Gladiators, If you haven't checked it out yet you should its free! :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/145c4381eca1c5fb8c6b6cb30e028f9a55dcc75b.png

 New Quests 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/944a24c3d5c75d534a4d22f0c3d777b89564f8b2.gif
Tons of new quests have been added and over 40 new NPCs and creatures have been added to the game! This includes a new puzzle type where you have to shoot down incoming asteroids coming at your ship!  

 New Cat Skin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/0bf1e53435c61440ba1f843fac8d6b442a884cb5.gif
NEW CAT SKIN!!! Some cats also have custom meows depending on their skins as well. On top of new cat skins we have added a ton of other ease of use things such as more info on what certain upgrades actually do and the sort! 

 Final thoughts 
The past year 10 months of Operation Zeta being released have been a whirlwind for me and the Studio as a whole! I love hearing everyone who has enjoyed the game and their thoughts on it. Feel free to let me know if you have any ideas of things you would want to see in future content updates or general just want to say hi. Thank you guys so much for letting me live me dream of making games.

notes.title: Small bugfix update! 1.0.4.1
notes.notes:

notes.notes:
Hey guys as we approach our release date (that will be announced super soon ;) ) We have a final build of the game to give you to you guys! This update has a whole ton of new content and polish in it. Here are just a few of the highlights.

 Better quest helpers 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/528c7e9f08dac637aad530d0e9895fa2ee40972d.png

We have added a ton of indicators and helpful pointers throughout the game. Such as boss monster HP bars, Arrows pointing to enemies that need to be killed, helper indicators on puzzles and much more!

 New quests 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/e78579495b4d7ed4214942b63494ce4daa316797.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/8e8c7491c06f62cd684ff5b280876f9daeada43a.png

As with most updates we have added a slew of new quests and NPCS. Above are a few of the new NPCS. Ranger Choi and Cheshire the Cheetah.

 Better creature variance 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/76028a4d8ab52b52eb25612cfc1f4eb7e24cd023.gif

More monster species have been added! As well each planet will now have more than just one monster type per planet. Pictured above is a Brump. They are a bat like creature with a deadly ranged sonar attack. Pictured below is a Frob, They hop around and sling their tongue around to hurt you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/2a14e5141284608d330527c11484a9712cfec445.gif

 More sounds 
In order to make the game feel more polished you will find we have added a lot more sound effects throughout the game as well. All attacks and special attacks now have custom sound effects for them!

As always guys thank you so much for all the support you have given OZ through Early Access on Steam! It has been a long road and massive learning experience for us. I am really happy with what the game has evolved into thanks to all of you guys. notes.title: Content Update: New character, Total revamp of other characters.
notes.notes:
Huge update for Operation Zeta for the one year anniversary in Early Access. This update is potentially the last major update before launch! The goal is to fix and polish the current feature set and set a date for full release soon. This update is jam packed full of new stuff. Lets get into some of the highlights.

 New Character Race: Meows 
We have added the 13th playable character the Meows! You may have seen them around as NPCS, but the cats are now playable. They have a unique way to play as they do not have a timer or even quests! Their goal is to collect enough shiny rocks to play with from the Gem golems scattered around the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/78be9c63c1741605cc67144b57a371b5d1e832ce.gif

 Fancier Character Select & Menus 
We have taken a look at all the menus in the game and revamped and changed most of them. First thing that will be noticed is we have added a info box for each character before selecting them. This will give you an idea of what this character can do and how hard they will be to play! Hopefully this will stop new players from trying to win with a droid before they are ready.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/0f9c32296705abe7c8f64c6e4e7c998ac8fb767a.png

 Character rebalance/ Variance 
One complaint people had about OZ was that a lot of the characters felt the same. We have gone through for each of the 13 characters and gave them more unique quests, dialogue, art and gameplay. For example a playthrough with Gibby is now an onslaught of battles while a playthrough with Florbo is solving a ton of puzzles. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/2d5ae19dff591565101c476fc9a7314a19e10f81.png

 Random Events 
Random events will now occur in the game. To further vary gameplay random events have been added. Sometimes it might be an incoming meteor show, sometimes it might be one of the sneaky Space Purrates to steal a ship part. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/f88944ea3fed1712738a00fea1f6ac0dc3d8878e.png

 New Upgrades 
We have added 6 new upgrades to get. From stopping the new Purrates from stealing your parts to a shield for your ship. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/11a1ff080b21f6718e415fee08f506edd5c731c0.png

 Other stuff 
Tons of other things have been added as well, such as new quests, Achievements & database entries. I'm excited for you guys to start exploring and find all of the new things. We even had time to add a couple fun new Easter Eggs. Let us know if you can find them.

 Final Thoughts & Future 
As stated at the start the goal of this update is to be a potential release build of the game. It certainly needs to go through some more looks from you guys as well as internally, however we plan to have a release date for OZ *VERY SOON* Keep your feedback coming and thank you for the support this past year of early access, I hope to bring you guys a fun and enjoyable game. As always please give us feedback here on Steam in the forums, or with a review (those help us a ton), Or come hang out with us on our Discord.

Thanks again guys.
-Ben

notes.title: Update 0.18 The Flaxon Five & more
notes.notes:
This weeks update is centered around the funky fresh music group, The Flaxon Five.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/f3a953525ba66a01041edf774f06a0f42425171a.gif

Tons of new database Entries
You can learn about the Flaxon Five as well as how many of the items and power ups work now with a ton of newly added database entries. You can now get lore entries by completing a quest for a NPC with a lore entry or by picking up a powerup or item with one. With more ways to get more lore entires this also means more ways to get upgrade credits! Rejoice! 

New Quests/boss/Items 
As always we have added a handful of new quests, and creatures to the world of OZ. Many of the new quests are from the Flaxon family as well as NPC influenced by them. This brings our total to 84 quests! The goal is to be over 100 with the next update so stay tuned. We have also added a new kind of powerup. A time Extender. It does exactly what you think it would, It extends the time you have left until the death laser fires. This powerup should help newer players start winning on harder characters earlier and experience more of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/a301faf68b3ce4c1177b09e65402717fe42fd93d.gif
This is Mailbox Max.. I would think twice putting mail in him


 Other things/ Final thoughts
We have been having a blast drawing more things and adding more content to OZ with you guys live on Twitch. Keep the support and feedback coming here on Steam with a review (those help us a ton) or on our Discord. The next update is going to be the largest update for OZ stay tuned for some really big news with OZ soon!

notes.title: Update 0.17 New character, New bosses & more
notes.notes:
Another update another new character and tons of new content! 

 Tons of New quests & more kinds of quests 
As with every update this update contains a whole boat load of new quests. On top of that there are new kinds of quests with tons of fun an unique NPCs. One of these is pictured below, we draw most of these fun NPCs live on Twitch so feel free to come join us in the development of OZ.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/b3efccfeb6e8c8c0c318c070d4f3166866fbe380.gif
Elon Muskrat asking for you to orbit his car

 New playable character: Gibby the gibbon
Also as with most updates we have added yet another playable character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/eed591a2b1d8a1eabd6bc429cd655f3301b1f6fd.gif
 The character select wheel is getting pretty full!!

Gibby is a member of the Sukinkina faction. The Sukinkina are the smaller faction of the Oohkin race who have a tentative truce with the galactic community for 'Operation Zeta' Gibby is armed with an explosive missile as well as missile barrage special ability! For those wanting a more combat heavy person to play Gibby is your character!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/86d2a98d8996e761644c331ccf9765bc21bd331a.png
 Gibby next to his big ship and small ship

Other fixes and improvements 
Overall we have taken other steps to address user feedback about our game. One complaint was that people would get overly motion sick during the game, as such we have started to change things to make things less nauseating. The first change was making the menu spin around the planet instead of spinning you around to the menu. We have some more sweeping ideas to make OZ more playable for everyone regardless of how motion sick they get!

 Final thoughts 
Thank you guys for the continued support and feedback! As OZ gets closer and closer to release expect more and more content to come out. Please let us know how we are doing or anything else you would want to see in the game with a review here on Steam or by joining our community on Discord.

notes.title: Update 0.16 Two new playable characters. Tons of new quests & more.
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Big update today. Two new playable characters have been added along with a ton of new quests and mechanics. 

 New Characters

 Danny The Dolphin 

Danny the Dolphin is one of the new playable characters! His ship building comes with a new challenge of you must also find water tanks to fill the ship before you can take off. Danny as well provides a neat new mechanic for attacking. He has bouncy explosive beach balls. Danny shoots out beach balls and can trigger them to explode whenever he pleases to impact maximum damage on enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/b9031ee5afba12fa710c67f7ba69cf3d585c66ed.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/594dee88af8db17ee550748b3aaedba79be6067a.gif

 Larry The Little Green man 
Humans have always wondered about little green men interfering in their business. Turns out Larry is one of them! Larry is under custody of 'Special Agent OZ' and he needs you to help repair the dimensional portal to get back to earth and away from this warzone. Larry wears a beret and has a crippling addiction to Starcups Drinks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/6b575ea413876e4b0b7621340abab7ee2e467ed0.gif


 Tons of new quests 
This is our largest dump of quests yet! there are 18 new quests that have been added to the game, with 26 new characters that have been added to support these quests and a new type of puzzle. Lots of the new creatures have new mechanics and will present interesting new ways to fight and work with them. Here are a few of them! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/f155f79fc0ac44e0f8a423de66e461f1c1d14f70.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/1b59698944e2d2ff65f64dfcbdea93d82f201059.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/ffee261ff91e52886c91d23b5004e1b44b9e21d3.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/d6e72220552e74929a9cc75c7c014fc7ab598120.gif


 Adding more variable weight 
Things on your ship will now weigh it down! There are new creature types that will latch on to your ship and keep you from taking off! As well grappling things will make your ship accelerate slower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/294573e7b696dfc8935f5c638894ea21e43bd4d5.gif

 Final thoughts 
This has been a large update and thanks in part to you guys! We have been streaming development of Operation Zeta on Twitch  and have loved having you guys get involved and watch the development process. If you checked us out there you will recognize a lot of the new characters! As always let us know what you like and don't. Leaving us a review on Steam helps us out a ton! Thanks guys, I look forward to sharing even more updates with you guys soon.

notes.title: Content Update: Droids, Drones & Drainage.
notes.notes:
Hey guys big update for OZ, Sorry for the long time between updates we are back from the holidays and back to having monthly updates! We have a lot of fun stuff in this one.

 Drone Upgrades 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/515b6b6afe7817b9f19cb655af8a493ec9eb1472.gif
Three new upgrades have been added to the upgrades page. With each level in them you will get a new drone that will follow around your character and do things for you. The attack drones will attack with you, The protection drones will give you temporary shielding and the health drones will passively heal you. They are worth checking out and may be the key to unlocking the new playable character....


New Playable character Droid
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/e9e095946b0d3a17759025248ccee3832841b247.gif
A new playable character has appeared! Droid plays unlike other characters instead of rebuilding your ship you are collecting scrap parts to bring back so you and your robot friend OZ can break them down. Droid alone is fairly weak and doesn't even get a small ship to fly around in. He however comes equipped with an autostablizer and a grappling magnet of his own. The key to being able to win a run with Droid is to have plenty of drones to help you out!

This brings us to a total of 9 playable characters in the game. We have plans for more even more crazy ones so the list will continue to grow!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/e6d7969966fa040a9bec33d5707596355be0f1a3.png

New NPCs and Quests 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/1542cfe4b82fefea251e0958b69acf01482a4690.gif
As we do in every update more quests and fun NPCs have been added! We have our 5th Cat, Bella, as the headliner new NPC. Who doesn't like cats?! She comes with a quest where you must find a claw trimmer for her before she claws your ship part!!
Two other NPCS and four other quests have been added as well. Below is Owen and Garm.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/21f171b40f4f75b361df431247367344cd051eaa.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/61b02814ab10343efc8fcbc89969f2cbc886308a.gif


Final Thoughts
As stated at the start we are back into high gear development and some really huge things are on the near horizon for OZ, The end of last year really left me feeling drained, but the new year has brought new life to development and monthly updates will now resume! As always let me know any feedback or questions you have. Thanks guys!

notes.title: Content Update: New quests, New NPCS & Powerups
notes.notes:
This week's update has a focus on adding more variety and quests to the game! As well as some new mechanics to make things more interesting.

 New Quest Types 
We have added a few new quest types. 
Tower puzzles:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/1c3d400270ee9aaa0296973245c9a3482c8136bf.png
In tower puzzles you have to quickly activate all the tiles with a red border before time expires. Failing to do so will reset the puzzle.

Delivery:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/b3ba60631031d20d36ee66491e163ff8d0325883.gif

notes.title: Content Update: Sandbox mode, Fire and Ice
notes.notes:
Tons of new stuff has been added this week! I'll quickly cover some highlights

 Sandbox mode 
A new sandbox mode has been added! No need to worry about the death laser coming to fire on you. You are on the other side building the death laser!! The death laser has 16 total parts needed to build it so it will take some time to complete it. As such you have many more planets to explore and do quests on in this game mode.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/8214ff8e94d259aab187b490b1c0b863a30bcfbf.gif

 New upgrades 
A couple new upgrades have been added. Including a home teleport while you are in your ship, and a damage reflecting ability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/01f4543ce9dad72f13703c351bada34f9be18ffd.png


 New Creatures 
We have added magma and ice golem variants! Ice golems will shatter into hail of ice shards when killed, as well magma golems will explode into fiery clumps of rock. On top of this we have added a large ice golem boss who constantly shoots out ice shards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/6eaf40c1e110cc93d0287e67ec0889188ded62d5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/8909e21d58edc506afa2de6613609f90ed01b41b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/db24a14b37ddfa1c7c07ca218147b17b4d1f18fa.png

 Volcanic planets
A new planet type has been added that is home to Magma golems. Be carefull as there are mini volcanos that will sometimes shoot out hot rocks that can damage you or your ship!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/08f2691abcafc5ad5a056a46f51652caaa2e0b35.gif


 Final thoughts 
The core of the game is getting very close to what we want to see in a final game! So a full release date should be announced very soon. This however doesn't mean that content updates will stop. We continue to add more quests/characters and more content to the game. Next update is in a few weeks keep the feedback coming and hope you enjoy!

notes.title: 0.11 Update Lore Database
notes.notes:
This weeks update is heavily focused on a new system that has been added, A lore database! As well we have added some other goodies.

 In game lore database
You can now unlock over 30 database entries in the game by discovering artifacts, doing quests and other mysterious ways. Unlocking them awards you credits for more upgrades as well as lore entries in the database! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/b5ab958b09f3911b9cf244e31d49eb86f3b14614.png

 Planet changes
We have revamped the planet generation a bit to make it so that some of the creature collection quests are easier. You are now guaranteed at least one of each planet type in each game. As well we have added Geyser worlds! Be careful the Geysers can shoot you off into space.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/2de728cd0a38fbe0d7f7fbbb8a82ed4aa99cb5c2.gif

 New NPCS  
We have added more quests and NPCS to the world! Burbs and Groks! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/4d6d76cca4d424af766647dbe898d7fb8f6b023c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/e8db210d8735eb706fb83062691ddad8319bc2e1.gif

 Final thoughts 
As always thanks for the support and feedback you have been giving us on the Discord  and elsewhere. Feel free to give us a review here on Steam or support us on our Patreon. We will draw and add any quest concept you have to OZ for all Patreon tiers!

notes.title: 0.10 Update: New playable race & more
notes.notes:
This weeks update added a new race and some features that have been suggested by you guys since launch. A lot of those suggestions came from our Discord, feel free to join if you want to see your ideas in future updates! 

New playable race: Golemite
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/9f7357723d8bc28b4808d5453d3fd727c51d888a.gif

Golemite has been added as a new playable race and has the largest ship in the game with 9 parts! They shoot out rocks at the ground in front of them and have a special that makes them explode out 12 rocks around them!

New quests
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/c06e4097485c10fe9e0f8a548658dea376725bf4.gif

New quests have been added! This includes a new quest from one of our patrons  who wanted to have a santa themed quest. (all patreon tiers get to design a quest)

In order to make this quest happen you can now grapple creatures! Some more new quests have been added to find and bring creatures to NPCS.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/9ec94fc4d1f65fd1642032b60ef16a16794a6013.gif

Mini map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/eb836fe744d0b5a9ca7ad6c99bc6e536dd75b074.png
Due to popular demand we have added a minimap to help you from getting lost in the system.

Other small improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38329865/740b7885ab673e7c4f6ce30ccb1268c42ce4d39d.png

We have added other small improvements such as Steam "Rich Presence" to show your friends what you are doing in the game!  

 Update Stream
Something we want to try to do is do a short livestream here on Steam and on Twitch going over some of the update as well as hearing from you guys about ideas for future updates and thoughts on this update. We will post a condensed version of the stream on Youtube later in the week.

 Final thoughts 
Overall thank you for all the support and feedback you guys have given OZ since launch. We are going to keep doing regular updates with more improvements, new quests, new mechanics and new races for the foreseeable future! Feel free to let us know anything you would like to see or what you think about the game on Discord, the Steam forums or in a review (they help us a ton).
